title: The F-Rank Tea Seller - Episode 1: Hunter's Chai (live-action movie look)
format: 16:9, keyframes 1280x720, animated at 1280x720 (Wan 2.2 image-to-video, 720p), upscaled to 1920x1080, 24 fps
style: photorealistic cinematic live action, like a big-budget superhero movie: real people with real skin and hair, anamorphic widescreen look, shallow depth of field, practical lantern and portal light, VFX for aura, magic and monsters, warm/teal colour grade; no cartoon, no comic text on screen (sounds only)
faces: every face is an invented AI person with one locked face reference per character; never a real actor or real person; Viktor must not look like any film hero (short slicked-back hair, black cape, modern silver plate armor)

cast.arjun: 18, dark brown skin, short messy black hair, brown eyes, slim, white kurta with rolled sleeves, red sash, red string bracelet
cast.viktor: late 20s, tall, broad shoulders, slicked-back blonde hair, blue eyes, silver armor, black cape, longsword
cast.meera: early 20s, brown skin, long black single braid, white robe with gold trim, wooden healer staff
cast.raghu: 30s, huge, bald, thick black beard, heavy armor, tower shield (name to confirm)

shots.see: Viktor in a dark cave, golden aura, glowing sword, blood on his cheek, a giant monster shadow behind
shots.motion: golden aura flickers and rises like flames, sparks drift up, cape moves, slow camera push in to his face
line: This power... where is it coming from?!

shots.see: extreme close-up of Viktor's glowing yellow eyes
shots.motion: pupils shrink, light flares across the eyes, tiny camera shake

shots.see: title card over the glowing Gate: THE F-RANK TEA SELLER, Episode 1: Hunter's Chai

shots.see: card: One hour earlier...

shots.see: Mumbai 2031 at dusk, skyscrapers, a giant glowing portal with a magic circle in a purple sky
shots.motion: slow pan right across the skyline, clouds swirl around the portal, birds fly past
line: Mumbai, 2031. Gates to monster dungeons have opened in every city on Earth.

shots.see: hunters walking out of a gate carrying glowing blue monster cores, a crowd cheering
shots.motion: hunters walk toward camera, cores glow and pulse, camera tracks back
line: Hunters go in. Monster cores come out. Hunters get rich.

shots.see: wide plaza from above, a stone archway Gate, a queue of armored hunters, lanterns, a tiny tea stall at the side
shots.motion: camera cranes down from high above toward the small tea stall, lanterns sway, crowd moves
line: And right next to the biggest Gate in the city... stands a tiny tea stall.

shots.see: Arjun pouring tea from a height into a glass, a long stream of tea, steam, lanterns
shots.motion: tea stream pours from the raised pot into the glass, steam rises, his arm lifts higher, he shouts happily
line: Chai! Hot chai! Ten rupees a glass!

shots.see: close-up of the tea stream landing in a glass, foam, steam
shots.motion: slow motion tea splash and foam, steam curls

shots.see: Arjun (realistic, not chibi) holding a glass, embarrassed smile, a bead of sweat, empty counter
shots.motion: he scratches the back of his head, small sigh, wind blows a paper cup past
line: Business is... a little slow today.

shots.see: freeze frame of Arjun with a hunter status card: ARJUN, 18, RANK F
shots.motion: made in the edit (status card slides in)
line: Arjun. Eighteen years old. Hunter rank: F, the weakest.

shots.see: Viktor, Meera and Raghu walking through the crowd, people filming them on phones
shots.motion: the three walk toward camera in slow motion, cape flows, phone flashes go off

shots.see: freeze on Viktor with a name card: VIKTOR HALE, B-RANK, 2M FOLLOWERS
shots.motion: made in the edit
line: Viktor Hale. B-Rank. Two million followers. Zero manners.

shots.see: Viktor pointing and laughing, arrogant
shots.motion: he throws his head back laughing and points at the camera
line: Ha! Look, everyone! It's the F-Rank tea boy!

shots.see: Arjun offering a glass of tea with a calm smile
shots.motion: he holds the glass out toward camera, steam rises, lantern light flickers on his face
line: Tea, sir? Good for the nerves before a dungeon.

shots.see: Viktor holding the glass, raised eyebrow, disgust
shots.motion: he sniffs the tea and pulls a face, eyebrow rises
line: Tea from an F-Rank? Is it poisoned with weakness?

shots.see: Meera placing coins on the counter, smiling
shots.motion: coins slide onto the counter, she smiles and tilts her head, braid swings
line: Viktor, be nice. Three teas, please.

shots.see: freeze on Meera with a name card: MEERA, HEALER
shots.motion: made in the edit
line: Meera. Healer. The only nice one in the party.

shots.see: Viktor gulping the tea, head back
shots.motion: he downs the tea in one gulp, throat moves, puts the glass down

shots.see: close-up of Arjun in lantern light, half-closed eyes, a small knowing smile, dark background
shots.motion: very slow push in, lantern light flickers, one corner of his mouth lifts
line: Good luck in there. ...One hour. That's all you get.

shots.see: from behind: the three hunters walking into the giant glowing portal, blue light
shots.motion: they walk into the portal, blue light swallows them, wind pulls the cape

shots.see: a giant ogre with a cleaver and monster wolves with red eyes in a cave, from below
shots.motion: the ogre roars at the camera, wolves lunge forward, dust shakes from the ceiling

shots.see: Raghu knocked flying backwards, his shield cracking
shots.motion: impact: he flies back, shield cracks, fragments and dust burst

shots.see: Viktor wounded, cut on his arm, clenched teeth, holding his sword
shots.motion: he staggers, grips his sword tighter, sweat drips
line: Tch! Since when are Level 9 ogres this strong?!

shots.see: Meera casting green healing magic, scared, shouting
shots.motion: green light spirals from her staff, her braid whips, she shouts

shots.see: Viktor looking at his own glowing hands, golden aura, eyes turning yellow
shots.motion: a golden aura bursts out from his body, light particles rise, his eyes light up

shots.see: Viktor's golden sword slash cutting through the ogre

shots.see: Meera and Raghu, jaws dropped, shocked
shots.motion: both stare, Raghu's jaw drops further, dust settles

shots.see: Viktor grinning, sword on his shoulder, golden sparkles

shots.see: Viktor slashing through a pack of monster wolves, golden trails
shots.motion: fast slashes, wolves thrown aside, camera whips with the swing
line: For the next fifty-eight minutes, Viktor was unstoppable.

shots.see: a clock-style timer on screen counting 02:00 to 58:00 over battle flashes

shots.see: Viktor jumping midair with his sword raised, the golden aura fading
shots.motion: he leaps toward the boss, aura flickers and starts to fade mid-jump

shots.see: timer hits 60:00 and turns red

shots.see: Viktor (realistic, not chibi) pale, sweating, nervous smile as his aura fizzles out
shots.motion: the last golden sparks fizzle away, he trembles, sweat drop

shots.see: the three hunters running away down a corridor, the minotaur chasing, dust
shots.motion: they sprint toward camera in panic, the minotaur charges behind, floor shakes

shots.see: Viktor lying on his back on the stone outside the Gate, injured, torn cape, portal light
shots.motion: camera slowly lowers above him, he breathes heavily, portal light pulses

shots.see: Viktor slamming his hands on the tea stall counter, shouting, bandages
shots.motion: he lunges at the counter and grabs it, glasses rattle
line: YOU! What did you put in that tea?!

shots.see: Arjun deadpan close-up, half-closed eyes
shots.motion: almost still: one slow blink, steam drifts across

shots.see: Meera holding coins, hopeful sparkle

shots.motion: very slow pull back, lamp flame flickers, he wipes a glass
line: That night. Nobody knew the truth about his tea.

shots.see: Arjun looking up at a floating blue status window, blue light on his face
shots.motion: the blue window flickers open, light washes over his surprised face
line: (status window) Hidden skill: Hunter's Chai. Anyone who drinks it borrows great strength... for one hour.

shots.see: a giant red eye opening inside the portal above the city, the tiny tea stall below
shots.motion: the eye opens slowly, the slit pupil narrows toward the stall, red light spreads
line: And deep inside the Gate... something had noticed.

rules: a character's keyframe is made with their face file as image 0 and 'the same person, with exactly the same face'
write ages as 'a young man of 18' (never 'boy'); state clean-shaven when needed
stills show calm moments; violence and impacts come from the motion step (the safety filter refuses violent stills)
Mumbai streets: name Indian details (marigold strings, oil lamps, Indian shop fronts with plain boards), never just 'lanterns'
signs: keep backgrounds dark or blurred so no fake letters can be read; frame tighter if needed
Raghu's shield is a separate tall rectangular steel tower shield held by a handle on his left arm
a correction of a picture is only for small changes; age and big changes need a fresh picture
